title: Digi International Launches Digi IX40, a 5G Edge Computing Industrial IoT Cellular Solution Purpose-Built for Industry 4.0
summary: Integrated with Digi Remote Manager®, this solution enables rapid processing, analysis and integration of industrial asset data, ultimately helping businesses minimize costs and boost productivity.
